title: axonopus siccus var. scaber
intro: Axonopus siccus var. scaber, commonly known as Wild Grass or Bristle Grass, is a type of grass species in the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Axonopus siccus var. scaber include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, lower body temperature, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
